observations: Photo 0 shows a marine engine installed/attached to a larger green machine/frame (looks like a boat/industrial setup).
The engine is grey/white with visible rust/dust and hoses/wiring; some parts look disconnected or exposed.
A large flywheel/pulley area is visible at the front/bottom of the engine.
No clear readable brand/model plate is visible in the photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a readable engine nameplate/label or model stamping that confirms 'Detroit 671'.

risks.risk: Engine model/series may be different from what the seller claims (pricing depends heavily on exact model and parts availability).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine identification plate/model stamping (or serial/model number) on the engine block/side, plus a photo of the full engine with the label in focus.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown marine engine (worst-case for value/parts), not as a confirmed Detroit 671.

risks.risk: Condition/operability is unknown (may be seized, missing parts, or not starting).
risks.proof: Video of a cold start (or at least cranking with ignition) and a short run showing stable idle; include a tachometer/working gauges if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / needs overhaul.

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incomplete setup (alternator, starter, fuel system components, wiring harness, cooling parts).
risks.proof: Photo checklist: show alternator, starter, fuel pump/injector lines, water pump/impeller area, exhaust manifold, and all hoses/wiring connections—close and in focus.

risks.risk: Major wear/corrosion or internal damage (marine engines often suffer from saltwater exposure).
risks.proof: Compression test results (or cylinder leak-down) and photos of cylinder head/valve area if accessible; also show any oil/coolant condition.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: mounting, shaft coupling, and gearbox/bellhousing alignment may not match the buyer’s boat/plant.
risks.proof: Photos of the gearbox/bellhousing, coupling/shaft connection, and mounting points; include measurements of shaft diameter and coupling type.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming buyer may need adaptation.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine nameplate/model/serial number (in focus) to confirm the exact model.
Video of cranking and (if possible) a start and short run with stable idle.
Photos of key accessories: starter, alternator, fuel pump/injector lines, water pump/impeller area, and exhaust manifold.
Compression test (or leak-down) results, plus photos of oil/coolant condition.
Photos of gearbox/bellhousing and the shaft/coupling connection with measurements.
response.reason: From photo 0, the engine model cannot be confirmed and operability/condition cannot be verified. Without proof, any price would be guesswork; request the identification plate and a start/run video first.
